Majors.Note: Major 3's final published shape (frozen retroactively from the baseline as of 3dafebd3, the last commit on the v3 line). Retained ONLY as the diff basis that Major 4's Breaks list is verified against — the v3 line is dead and no Uplink was ever built against it. Its own Breaks list is empty because no Major-2 floor is recorded to diff against.

Frozen at v4.1. NOTE the provenance: an intermediate v4.0 (commit 57daa136) briefly published a DIFFERENT v4 shape (VesselControl.ActionGroups as System.Boolean[]) before the action-group retype was collapsed onto the same Major. That collapse is ratified on ContractVersion.Major's stated grounds — the mod is pre-release, no artifact was ever built against the intermediate v4.0, so exactly one v4 will ever be seen: this one. This ledger entry is that ratification, made explicit and machine-checked. It is frozen: every future v4.x Minor must be additive over this Shape.

Frozen at v5.0. The thermal channel carries kelvin only. HeatShieldTempCelsius was the sole temperature on vessel.thermal not in K, and that inconsistency was actively producing a wrong readout: ThermalStatus read hottestPart.skinTemp (genuinely K) as Celsius, showed it about 273 degrees high, and guarded it with a Celsius sentinel that could never fire on a kelvin value, so a vessel with no thermometer rendered a temperature instead of dropping the row. One unit per channel removes the choice that was being got wrong; Celsius is a presentation unit the client now asks for by name. Sanctioned on the standing pre-release grounds: no external Uplinks, and the app and mod ship together.

Frozen at v6.0. Removed the dead Meta.Confidence (double?). The mod declared it and the serializer wrote it only when meta.Confidence.HasValue, but nothing ever set it on an outgoing frame (the sole Confidence= assignment in the mod was the deserializer reading an incoming frame), so it was always null on the wire and always omitted from the JSON: a slot every consumer had to account for and none could read. A removed member on a wire-visible type is breaking by definition, so it is a Major, not a Minor. Jon approved the removal (2026-08-02). Sanctioned on the same standing grounds as every Major before it: the mod is still pre-release with no external Uplinks, and the app and mod ship together, so no artifact exists that was built against the old shape. See local_docs/design/specs/2026-08-02-units-game-RESOLVED-local-files.md.

Frozen at v7.0. The Avionics relocation: AvionicsStatus left Sitrep.Contract entirely, relocated into GonogoAvionicsUplink.Contract (uplink-types-out-of-core plan, second step after the MechJeb pilot). Unlike MechJeb's two command-arg types, AvionicsStatus predates the v6.0 freeze (added as an additive Minor on the Major-4 line, carried forward through Major 5 and Major 6), so it IS part of the frozen v6.0 floor: removing it is a genuine type-removed break against that floor, not a vacuous one, which is why this is a Major and not another Minor. Sanctioned on the same standing grounds as every Major before it: the mod is still pre-release with no external Uplinks, and the app and mod ship together, so no artifact exists that was built against the old shape; the wire FORMAT of avionics.status is unchanged, only which assembly declares it. See local_docs/design/2026-08-10-uplink-types-out-of-core-plan.md.
